indicator_name: Total resource flows for development (e.g. official development assistance, foreign direct investment and other flows)

sources.organisation: Basque Agency for Cooperation and Solidarity

objetivo_global: 10- Reduce inequality within and among countries
meta_global: 10.b Encourage official development assistance and financial flows, including foreign direct investment, to States where the need is greatest, in particular least developed countries, African countries, small island developing States and landlocked developing countries, in accordance with their national plans and programmes
definicion: Official Development Assistance from the regional and local  administrations of the Basque Autonomous Community (total gross disbursement)
formula:
$$ODA^{t}$$

where: 

$ODA^{t} $= amount of Official Development Assistance in year $t$
justificacion_global:
Total resource flows to developing countries quantify the overall 
expenditures that donors incur in these countries. 

Source: United Nations Statistics Division
dato_global: Total resource flows for development, by recipient and donor countries (millions of current United States dollars) DC_TRF_TFDV UNSTATS
comparabilidad: The available indicator doen't comply with the United Nations metadata, but provides similar information.

es.objetivo_global: 10- Reduce inequality within and among countries
es.meta_global: 10.b Encourage official development assistance and financial flows, including foreign direct investment, to States where the need is greatest, in particular least developed countries, African countries, small island developing States and landlocked developing countries, in accordance with their national plans and programmes
es.definicion: Ayuda Oficial al Desarrollo de la Administración Autonómica y Local de la CAPV (desembolso bruto total)
es.formula:
$$AOD^{t}$$

donde: 

$AOD^{t} $= Cantidad de Ayuda Oficial al Desarrollo en el año $t$
es.justificacion_global:
Los flujos totales de recursos hacia los países en desarrollo cuantifican 
los gastos generales que los donantes realizan a dichos países.

Fuente: División de Estadísticas de las Naciones Unidas
es.dato_global: Flujos totales de recursos para el desarrollo, por países receptores y donantes (millones de dólares corrientes de los Estados Unidos) DC_TRF_TFDV UNSTATS
es.comparabilidad: El indicador disponible no cumple con los metadatos del indicador de Naciones Unidas, pero aporta información similar.
